    Router restart required
    
          
    
            
    
              The container package is now enabled, and the router has to restart before it can run
              containers.
            
    
            
    Restart the router yourself, then confirm below.
    
            
    Use the MODE button while the router is powered on:
    
            
            
    
              On other models, use System > Reboot in Winbox or WebFig, or unplug the power and
              plug it back in.
            
    
            
    The installer waits for the router to come back and carries on by itself.
